openings.claim: Relocate ledger support into local-script manifest-indexed stage-graph edges carrying record IDs, comparable digests and uncertainty; missing support blocks definite claims. Removed transform record -> empty manifest slot -> invalid support edge -> recomputed unresolved interval plus next check using remaining records, never presumed nonexecution. Analyst verifies comparability, selects checks and owns conclusions; mapping, identifier validation and inspection logging consume analyst time.
openings.discriminator: Against an ordinary claim/record ledger with manual final rereading, predict visible retraction of solely deleted-supported claims and exposed intervals. Conclusions may match; accuracy/time gains are unestablished. Matching ingest digests prove recorded equality only; export mismatch without transform support cannot establish transform divergence.
openings.probe: Within sixty minutes prepare both variants and baseline outputs for six pairs, assigning disjoint three-pair subsets; log at most twelve manual inspections per pair across all passes. Freeze baselines, apply stipulated random transform-record deletions in two pairs with manifests unchanged, freeze finals, then open two sealed answer sheets. Spend twenty additional minutes comparing supported boundaries, intervals and unsupported claims. Test whether restoration cancels gap signals; blank warnings and reversed timestamps must not falsely signal absence. Subset differences confound variant comparisons: emphasize within-variant before/after behavior.
openings.uncertainty: Manifest/dictionary must permit artifact-boundary matching; otherwise preserve uncertainty. Expected order guides layout, not actual execution chronology: reversed timestamp remains observed mismatch with unresolved explanation. Defeat: incomplete mapping, unsupported comparability, redundant-support deletion yielding no changed conclusion, or insufficient setup time. Report limits; time cap alone cannot validate probe. Declared fit preserves depends on meeting resource caps; feasibility remains unproven. Separate mismatch from explanation; every definite stage needs supplied-record citation.

lineage.reason: Relation, rival, challenges, defeats, uncertainty and caps retained.

decision: Retain one bounded hypothesis. Report earliest supported stage or unresolved interval, record references and feasible next check for each pair. Synthetic results authorize no deployment/live-system claims.
